Doctor_Bio:
17 years of professional experience | Since 2009
Since 2009, my professional work has been entirely dedicated to obstetrics-gynecology and women's health care.
Over these 17 years, my accumulated clinical experience covers the management of pregnancy and childbirth, the diagnosis and treatment of gynecological conditions, as well as gynecological endoscopic surgery.
To me, being a doctor is not just about correctly determining a diagnosis and treatment. It is especially important to listen to the patient, thoroughly assess their condition, and offer a clear, individualized treatment plan.
Testimonial_1_Text: Dr. Tamar was incredibly supportive throughout my high-risk pregnancy. Her competence gave me confidence at every stage.
Testimonial_2_Text: The option of an online consultation was a lifesaver in the third trimester. Fast, professional and reassuring every time.
Testimonial_3_Text: From the first visit to delivery, I felt fully cared for. The whole team is absolutely exceptional.
Cta_Home_Desc: Book your first visit and get expert care from day one.
Services_Section_Subtitle: From the first trimester to the postpartum period — we're by your side every step of the way.
Experience_1_Role: Obstetrician-gynecologist, physician in charge of the obstetric department team.
Experience_2_Role: Obstetrician-gynecologist, physician in charge of the obstetric department team.
Professional_Development_Desc: An important part of my professional work is continuously updating my knowledge and learning modern medical approaches.
Dev_1_Text: Reproductive Health training course — seminar participant.
Dev_2_Text: General course on Karl Storz equipment and instrument handling technique, care and operation.
Dev_4_Text: Intensive course in gynecological endoscopic surgery.
Dev_5_Text: Medical congress — Hysteroscopy, hysterectomy and minimally invasive approaches in hysterectomy.
Dev_6_Text: Medical congress — Treatment of uterine fibroids in laparoscopic gynecology.
Dev_7_Text: GESEA - European Society for Gynaecological Endoscopy. Certificate of completion of the Winners Project quizzes at Bachelor level, eligible to take GESEA.
Direction_1_Text: Pregnancy monitoring, risk assessment, management of pregnancy and childbirth.
Direction_2_Text: Pre-conception consultation, assessment of necessary examinations and health status before pregnancy.
Direction_3_Text: Diagnosis, treatment and preventive monitoring of women's reproductive health issues.
Direction_4_Text: Hysteroscopy and laparoscopic operations for relevant gynecological conditions.
Direction_5_Title: Uterine Fibroids, Polyps and Other Gynecological Pathologies
Direction_5_Text: Diagnosis, determining treatment tactics and, if necessary, planning surgical treatment.
Direction_6_Title: Women's Health at Every Life Stage
Direction_6_Text: From reproductive age through pregnancy, the postpartum period, and health for women aged 40+.
My_Approach_Quote: "Every woman is different — that's why the medical approach must be individual too."
My_Approach_Text1: Over 17 years of practice, the relationship and trust between doctor and patient have become especially important to me.
My_Approach_Text2: I try to listen to every patient, assess their condition in detail, and explain not only what needs to be done, but why a particular approach is necessary.
My_Approach_Text3: I believe an informed patient makes calmer, more thoughtful decisions about their own health.
My_Approach_Goal_Intro: My goal is for every patient to leave a visit with me with three main things:
Professional_Principle_Text1: Medicine is constantly evolving. That's why it's important for me to continuously update my professional knowledge, stay familiar with modern guidelines and medical approaches, and apply that knowledge in daily practice.
Professional_Principle_Text2: I combine 17 years of experience with modern medical knowledge to offer every woman medical care tailored to her needs.
